ja412:1.1: Ahaṃ dasasataṃvyāmaṃ uragam ādāya-m-āgato, tañ ca mañ ca mahākāyaṃ dhārayaṃ na-ppavedhasi.
ja412:2.1: Atha imaṃ khuddakaṃ pakkhiṃ appamaṃsataraṃ mayā dhārayaṃ vyadhase bhīto kam atthaṃ koṭisimbalīti.
ja412:3.1: Maṃsabhakkho tuvaṃ rāja, phalabhakkho ayaṃ dijo, ayaṃ nigrodhabījāni pilakkhadumbarāni ca assatthāni ca bhakkhetvā khandhe me odahissati.
ja412:4.1: Te rukkhā saṃvirūhanti mama passe nivātajā, te maṃ pariyonandhissanti, arukkham maṃ karissare.
ja412:5.1: Santi aññe pi rukkhāse mūlino khandhino dumā iminā sakuṇajātena bījam āharitā hatā.
ja412:6.1: Ajjhārūḷhābhivaḍḍhanti brahantam pi vanaspatiṃ, tasmā rāja pavedhāmi sampassaṃ nāgataṃ bhayan ti.
ja412:7.1: Saṃkeyya saṃkitabbāni rakkheyya nāgataṃ bhayaṃ, anāgatabhayā dhīro ubho loke avekkhatīti.
